name: Wakde
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Grace, George W. 1972. Notes on the phonological history of the Austronesian languages of the Sarmi Coast. Irian: Bulletin of West Irian Development 1(3): 21-54 (reprint of the 1970/1971 paper, with Indonesian ichtisar).
sources.note: Image-only scan; TOC/contributor pages and pp. 13-14, 24-26 scanned to confirm it is the same article as the ERIC version (same text); no stress statement in the scanned pages, and the full ERIC text is silent.

sources.citation: Grace, George W. 1970. Notes on the phonological history of the Austronesian languages of the Sarmi Coast. Working Papers in Linguistics (University of Hawaii) 2(9): 55-104. ERIC ED054658. [= Oceanic Linguistics 10: 11-37 (1971)]
sources.note: Nothing. Historical phonology only (Proto-Oceanic consonant and vowel reflexes, canonical forms, vowel loss) for Sobei, Wakde ('Wakdé'), Masimasi, Anus, Bonggo, Tarpia from Grace's 1955-56 vocabularies; text a full-text search for stress/accent/penult/promin/length and sections I-III read; no statement on word stress or accent in any of the six languages.

sources.citation: Badan Bahasa (Kemdikbud), Peta Bahasa: 'Sobey Wakde' entry (petabahasa.kemdikbud.go.id, infobahasa2.php?idb=631&idp=Papua) and Papua province list page.
